name: Control Console Operating Manual
summary: At the Venture Company site southwest of Sludge Fen, the Control Console Operating Manual guides workers through the machinery. It explains how to close the valves and disengage the samophlange.

sections.title: Deciphering Goblin Machinery
sections.body: Southwest of Sludge Fen, the Venture Company runs a drilling and research site in the northern Barrens. Its machinery links gauges, pressurized valves, and mechanisms to a device called a samophlange. Without the right instructions, working the volatile controls can cause a dangerous failure or lock the system. The manual gives the valve sequence for disengaging the core apparatus without triggering an explosive failure.

faq.q: What is the Control Console Operating Manual used for?
aliases: why do i have operating manual
faq.answer: The Control Console Operating Manual explains how to work the Venture Company console southwest of Sludge Fen. It guides you through closing the valves so the samophlange can be disengaged.

Even the researchers outside the Venture Company do not fully understand what a samophlange does. It appears to be a goblin-engineered core mechanism tied to drilling and industrial work in the Barrens.

Venture Company technicians overseeing the research outpost drafted the manual. It was meant to help workers operate the console and keep pressure levels across its control valves at their intended levels.

faq.q: What happens if I lose the manual?
faq.answer: The console has gauges and readouts showing valve pressure. A skilled adventurer can read its face and operate the switches without the manual in hand.

angles.text: The manual shows a goblin approach to engineering: highly pressurized, marginally safe systems run by a chaotic array of levers and valves instead of balanced failsafes.
The manual gives Horde investigators a look inside the Venture Company's invasive industrial operations across the northern Barrens.
